description: Manifest of C# .tmpl files emitted by the api-wrapper-scaffold agent. Lists each template and the {{Token}} placeholders it requires. Tests in .github/agents/tests/csharp-templates.Tests.ps1 enforce manifest <-> body parity.

tokens.ProjectName: PascalCase wrapper name, e.g. TripItEx. Used for class names, exception types, MCP tool prefix, and per-user storage folder.
tokens.Namespace: Root .NET namespace, e.g. TripIt. Auth types live under {Namespace}.Auth.
tokens.BaseUrl: HTTPS scheme + host of the target site, e.g. https://www.tripit.com.
tokens.AuthModel: One of cookie, cookie+csrf, bearer, sso-google, sso-microsoft, sso-facebook, oauth2-pkce. Recorded as a banner comment in the MCP entry point.
tokens.IdpName: Friendly IdP name (Google / Microsoft / Facebook). Substituted into the generated authenticator's bot-challenge messages.
tokens.IdpAuthorizeUrl: OAuth 2.0 authorize endpoint of the IdP, e.g. https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth. Baked into OAuthPkceAuthenticator.
tokens.IdpTokenUrl: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint of the IdP, e.g. https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token. Baked into OAuthPkceAuthenticator.
tokens.IdpClientId: OAuth 2.0 client id registered with the IdP for this wrapper. Public PKCE client - no secret required.
tokens.IdpScopes: Space-delimited OAuth scopes to request, e.g. 'openid email profile'.
tokens.HasMobileCoverage: String 'true' or 'false'. Set by the agent when Phase 1.5 (Mobile App Discovery, issue #44) contributed at least one HAR or endpoint list to the generated client. Drives the README.MobileDiscovery section.
tokens.MobileHarPaths: Newline-joined list of mobile HAR paths (relative to project root) that fed the generated client. Empty when HasMobileCoverage is 'false'.
